title: Death of John Norseen

tellings.quote: Norine died while on business for Concurrent Technologies on September 27th, 2007.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named John Norseen died on September 27, 2007, while on business for a company called Concurrent Technologies. He tells it in an episode about top American scientists who have gone missing or died, placing Norseen's death among cases he thinks deserve a closer look.
